experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented REST and gRPC APIs for cross-product communication, with pagination, filtering, audit information, and backward-compatible Protocol Buffer contracts validated through contract-style tests.

Upgraded a microservice application across 20 Java modules from Spring Boot 2.6 to 3.5, redesigning security configuration for Spring Security 6, migrating Jakarta APIs, and upgrading five generated API-client modules.
Implemented concurrency controls for long-running jobs using centralized mutation guards and dedicated status APIs; connected backend state to progress tracking and conflict handling in the frontend.
Optimized MongoDB data access using targeted indexes, bulk reads, and batched audit retrieval; developed migration logic to transform and upsert legacy records.

Applied GitHub Copilot and iterative agent workflows across feature development, root-cause analysis, scenario design, debugging, and code review while independently owning architecture and validation.

experience.title: Application Developer
bullets: Developed ERP mobile application modules using MVVM, separating user interfaces from presentation and application logic.
Improved API-backed data retrieval by approximately 30% by refining retrieval logic and eliminating unnecessary processing in ERP workflows.
